resources.string: Built for privacy and trust. Zero trackers, zero hidden permissions, and zero data collection. Your Google account stays strictly between your device and Google.
Know someone who needs a website or custom software? Earn 10% on every closed project.
Enjoy YouTube Music completely ad-free with background and screen-off playback—crafted by Studio Mogli.
1. Your Google Account Stays Strictly Private
Sign-in happens directly on Google\'s official login page inside an isolated window. Studio Mogli never sees, touches, or stores your email or password.
2. Why We Technically Cannot Collect Your Data

This app has zero backend servers, zero analytics SDKs, and zero ad trackers. It only requests Internet and Notification permissions needed to play audio—no contacts, storage, camera, or location access.
Press the power button or switch apps anytime and your music keeps playing uninterrupted. (Tip: Set Battery to Unrestricted in App Info for best results.)
